caption: Probability that ECI wage growth is in its high-wage-inflation regime (2-state HMM). In THIS floored re-run the HMM probability is the TRADED WINNER SIGNAL (it was supporting context before): the rule holds SPY when the 4-quarter-lagged probability is BELOW its rolling z = 1 threshold (low-stress = risk-on) and steps to CASH when above — countercyclical. The high-wage-inflation state covers 47% of quarters and peaks in the 2021–23 wage surge; concurrent SPY returns are better in the LOW state. An HMM-derived probability is more opaque than a raw transform — a complexity caution. Shaded bands mark NBER recessions.
narrative_alignment_note: hmm_stress IS the winner signal in the floored re-run; reframed from 'context' to 'traded signal', with the countercyclical rule and the opacity caution stated.
